server.name: io.github.AsaiShota/mcp-server
server.description: Let AI agents pay-per-call for any HTTP API via x402 on Base mainnet. One tool: pay_and_call.
server.title: x402-market

environmentVariables.description: Marketplace API base URL.
environmentVariables.name: MARKET_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: Funded buyer wallet private key (0x-prefixed). Required for pay_and_call; read-only tools work without it.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Base RPC endpoint. Defaults to Base mainnet public RPC; Alchemy/QuickNode recommended for higher rate limits.
environmentVariables.name: BASE_RPC_URL

environmentVariables.description: 8453 = Base mainnet (default, matches live listings). 84532 = Base Sepolia testnet.
environmentVariables.name: BASE_CHAIN_ID

environmentVariables.description: Hard cap on per-call cost (USDC). Refuses to pay above this.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_MAX_PRICE

server.name: io.github.AshwanthramKL/whoop-mcp
server.description: Read-only WHOOP v2 data for MCP clients, with local SQLite cache and CSV/JSONL/Parquet exports.

environmentVariables.description: Client ID from your WHOOP developer app (https://developer-dashboard.whoop.com/apps/create).
environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Client secret from your WHOOP developer app. Used for OAuth token refresh.
environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: OAuth redirect URI. Defaults to http://localhost:8000/callback — only change if you registered a different URI.
environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_REDIRECT_URI

environmentVariables.description: Log level (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR). Default INFO.
environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Path to the rotating log file. Set to empty string to disable file logging. Default ~/.whoop-mcp-server/logs/whoop-mcp.log.
environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_LOG_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Structured JSON logs (true) vs human-readable (false). Default true.
environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_LOG_JSON
